column1: # Abstract case → particle. G picks the first row whose case and condition hold, then the allomorph
# from the last sound of the word before it (vowel, consonant, ㄹ). Lexical particles (kase=lex) are
# written in the same notation in the node lemma: 이/가, 과/와 (after a consonant/after a vowel), (으)로, (이)나, or one form.
#   kase    subj top obj gen dat src loc goal instr com quot voc
#   when    - | anim | hon | spoken | a comma-joined AND of these
#   form    notation as above: A/B = after a consonant / after a vowel
